review.official:
Sussurro is a graduate of the
Siracusa
-Palermo Medical Academy. She has a sufficient level of knowledge in basic medical care.
She is now a
medic
at
Rhodes Island
and is a respected member of the headquarters' logistics system.

files.description:
Imaging tests have shown the outlines of her internal organs to be indistinct due to abnormal shadows. Originium granules have been detected in her circulatory system, confirming her to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 2%
Patient's oripathy is mild and currently shows no indications of spreading.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L
Patient's disease is under control.

Sussurro was born to an ordinary family in a large city in Siracusa. Her parents were ordinary citizens who worked in local public institutions. They had two sons and two daughters. Sussurro was their third child.
Although Sussurro's parents wanted her to be a quiet, obedient child, she did not respond positively to these expectations. Sometimes this was to help her younger sister get back snacks her brothers had stolen, and sometimes this was to help her sister get a hold of a toy she couldn't have. Since her childhood, Sussurro has developed a personality that takes initiative.
Sussurro's two older brothers have already grown up and have gone into business. Her younger sister is studying in kindergarten. Sussurro herself chose to study medicine. She did not do so out of any grand ambition or dream, but because the medical industry in Siracusa holds promise and is a good field to work in.

Sussurro's life as a medical student was uneventful. She busied herself preparing for exams and participating in experiments. Her small figure was often bouncing between the different buildings on campus, and her short stature notwithstanding, all of her abilities steadily progressed.
Luckily for Sussurro, she got to make a solid group of friends between classes and maintained good relationships with some older students. These medical students all embraced the same dreams, confronted the same challenges, and worked towards the future together. With everyone's help and encouragement, Sussurro managed to press on through the long, dull days in her time as a medical student.
Though Sussurro originally had no aspirations of her own, through making friends with all kinds of people, she gradually came to understand the reasoning behind their choices. Whether it was to secure a job with a stable salary and life environment, out of a genuine desire to help others, or just out of pure interest in biology, Sussurro found their aspirations infectious. She liked everyone who had a dream and worked hard to fulfill it, and at the same time, her own thinking became clear:
Does becoming a doctor hold any special meaning for me?

When the oripathy crisis gradually worsened throughout every major city, people were forced to confront an all-new and unknown illness. Now, both public and private hospitals were packed with patients, and medical resources became strained. Sussurro's clinical instructor as well as her seniors all participated in efforts to combat the disease.
Faced with a notice that all major hospitals were recruiting medical students to act as volunteers, Sussurro did not think twice about signing up. It was at this moment that she felt she was finally a medical student, and she found genuine purpose.

Sussurro did not think about the fact that she had become infected by volunteering to participate in the treatment of the infected. Even when three days had passed since she herself had been transformed from doctor to infected, she did not feel anything. Everything just seemed to happen so suddenly.
It wasn't until she witnessed a patient be declared untreatable and get sent to the intensive care unit with a blank stare that she made the connection between herself and the situation at hand.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Time for a break, Doctor. Just how long have you been sitting at a table like that? Get up and go stretch out a little. Yes, I mean now.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It is my duty to perform regular check-ups on Oripathy patients. Some are personable enough, but a few are hard to communicate with. It's not the first time, though, so worry not, they will understand how vital a doctor is to them.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You know what an amnesia patient should pay attention to, Doctor? Don't work yourself into the ground. Work and relaxation are equally important!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You always have patients who ignore the doctor's orders, but in battle, you don't see a doctor who'd miss a single cry for help.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: The advancement of medicine is a lesson taught by none other than the cruelty of war and disasters, a lesson we medical workers learn through pain and suffering... But... It's a fact I figured out long ago. As long as I can help my patients get their lives back, I'm ready to face the fact.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Together we've spent some... uh, I mean, some most memorable moments! Come on, you know I'm not good at this, Doctor. And next time I see you put up that teasing face, I'd be real mad!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Here's a pen. How did I know you wanted it? Well, I've been working with you for a while now, isn't it natural I picked up on it?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm still far below the level of Silence and Shining, but that doesn't mean I can't overcome an obstacle when I see one before me. Otherwise, how can I measure up to your confidence in me?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The sun's good on the deck, and the wind's just fine… Mm? No, I'm not slacking off. It's just... I'm feeling swamped right now, like you occasionally do, Doctor. So, anything bothering you? Mm-hm, keep it as a whisper if it's easier for you this way. I'm listening.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Who came up with this meal plan? I'm having spasms in my stomach just by looking at the list!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Sussurro, Medic, reporting in with a little reminder for the Doctor. Now, I understand you have a lot on your plate, and even if they say a 'doctor' makes the worst patient, you need to follow our advice.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I must make more copies of these battle notes for Myrrh and company.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion ceremony, while everyone stares at me? I don't have to make any embarrassing speeches, do I? No, no, I'm not nervous at all, really...

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: For this promotion, I have the entire Medical Department to thank, who's been supporting me all the time with their hard work. And of course, thank you too, Doctor, for your guidance. I'm very, very grateful to you all!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Don't worry, I'll watch over them.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Hold everything! You must complete all pre-battle physical exams to deploy!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Attention, medics, make sure to follow all standard procedures in battle. Now, to your positions.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Safety first, and do not touch anything that may be suspicious or infected!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'm over here!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Speak louder! It's hard to hear over the battle!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Medic's here! Here!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Anybody hurt?

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Don't worry, you'll be okay in no time!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't concern yourself with fighting, you're still wounded!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Listen to the doctor!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Scream if you're in pain, don't hold it in!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Finally, the battle's over. You should take a break too. I imagine commanding the mission would take a toll on your body.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No casualty on our side. The Doctor's leadership is indeed unparalleled.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Will the enemy return? There are still wounded unable to move here.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Make way, make way! Stop crowding! Wounded coming through!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Promise you'll rest when it's time to, okay?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Um…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Phew. I need a drink after work! Mind handing me a juice, Doctor? Thanks!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. New Year's is a time for proper relaxation, and you can't overstress yourself. I know you'll be at the dining table soon, though, and you can't let yourself go too much. I remember how bad your indigestion was after you overate last year. I'll keep an eye on you this time!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: How do you do, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I made you a cylinder cake—they seem popular lately. You don't need to hide it, I figured you'd be rolling in cakes today long beforehand... Anyway, don't eat too much, whatever you do! Watch your sugar intake!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I don't know how much longer life will carry on like this. Sometimes I even feel like I can't make out the future ahead, but if it even gets to us medics, how much worse must it be for our patients, waiting for us to treat them? I'm sure we'll see the light of dawn one day, Doctor.
